meta.title: John Football Coaching — Orange County, FL
meta.description: Professional football coaching in Orlando, FL. Training sessions for youth and high school athletes.

about.name: Coach John
about.bio:
Hi, I’m Coach John Latimer—a U.S. Army Soldier, dedicated mentor, and multi-sport athlete with a primary focus in basketball, along with experience in football and swimming. Through Athletes United, I combine the structure and discipline from my military background with the teamwork and competitive spirit gained from years of athletic experience to help young athletes grow not just in sport, but in life.

When kids train with me, they’re not just learning how to dribble, shoot, or run plays—they’re learning how to lead, stay resilient under pressure, and be accountable teammates. My coaching approach centers on mental toughness, fundamentals, and character building. I believe in creating a positive, high-energy environment where every athlete, regardless of skill level, feels motivated to improve and confident in their growth.

I’m committed to helping each athlete unlock their full potential, both on and off the field. Whether they’re chasing scholarships or just building lifelong habits, I’m here to guide, push, and support them every step of the way.
